pages: Day 1 of breathing. Pulse 40. Cough absent for the first time in eleven months. Appetite absent. Sleep absent. Dreams absent. I note with interest that I do not miss any of them.
Day 9. Pulse 31. The skin of the hands has gone grey to the wrist. I cut the left palm to see whether it would bleed. It did, slowly, and then it thought better of it.
Day 30. Pulse not found. I am writing this. Therefore the physicians were wrong about what a pulse is for.
